### 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or a workflow bottleneck in Asteria Club? 
Example: *"As an HoD, it is difficult to quickly see which members haven't checked in for 2 weeks..."*

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution & Design
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.
- Which page / route does this belong to (`/dashboard`, `/tasks`, `/attendance`, `/members`, etc.)?
- How should it interact with Supabase (new tables, new columns, RLS policies)?
- Does it require bilingual translation (FR/EN)?

### 🎨 Charte Graphique Considerations
Does this feature adhere to Asteria Charte Graphique 2026 (colors, typography, fluid easing curves)?

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
